news.titleTr: Enflasyonu doları uçurdu! Dört haftanın zirvesi görüldü: Piyasanın gözü cuma gününde
news.summaryTr: ABD'de beklentileri aşan enflasyon verisi doları dört haftanın zirvesine taşıdı. Fed'in aralık ayında faiz artırması beklenirken, cuma günü açıklanacak ÜFE verisi doların yeni yönünü belirleyebilir.
news.articleText: Enflasyonu doları uçurdu! Dört haftanın zirvesi görüldü: Piyasanın gözü cuma gününde - ABD'de beklentileri aşan enflasyon verisi doları dört haftanın zirvesine taşıdı. Fed'in aralık ayında faiz artırması beklenirken, cuma günü açıklanacak ÜFE verisi doların yeni yönünü belirleyebilir. ABD'de beklentilerin üzerinde gelen enflasyon verisi doların küresel piyasalarda son dört haftanın en yüksek seviyesine çıkmasını sağladı. Fed'in aralık ayında faiz artıracağı beklentisi güçlenirken, cuma günü açıklanacak Üretici Fiyat Endeksi (ÜFE) verisi doların yönü açısından kritik önem taşıyor. Fed'in faiz artırımı beklentisi doları destekledi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD'de salı günü açıklanan tüketici enflasyonu verilerinin beklentileri aşması, doların diğer önemli para birimleri karşısında değer kazanmasına yol açtı. Verilerin ardından Fed'in aralık ayındaki toplantısında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımına gideceği beklentisi güçlendi. Piyasalarda daha yüksek oranlı bir faiz artışı ihtimali de yakından izleniyor. Dolarda yeni yükseliş için 50 baz puanlık artış beklentisi DHF Capital S.A. analisti Bas Kooijman, doların yükselişini sürdürebilmesi için Fed'in 50 baz puanlık faiz artırımı yapacağına yönelik beklentilerin güçlenmesi gerekebileceğini belirtti. Kooijman, aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık artışın zaten temel senaryo olduğunu, doların daha fazla değer kazanması için yarım puanlık faiz artışı ihtimalinin daha güçlü fiyatlanması gerektiğini ifade etti. Gözler cuma günü açıklanacak ÜFE verisinde Kooijman'a göre cuma günü açıklanacak ABD Üretici Fiyat Endeksi (ÜFE) verisi, doların seyrinde belirleyici olabilir. ÜFE'nin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi veya Fed yetkililerinden sıkı para politikasını destekleyen açıklamaların gelmesi doların yeni kazançlar elde etmesini sağlayabilir. Buna karşılık verilerin zayıf kalması durumunda doların son dönemdeki yükselişinin bir bölümünü geri vermesi beklenebilir.

news.title: KAP'ta temerrüt bildirimi: Üç şirketin borç ödemesi gerçekleşmedi
news.summary: Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu (MKK), Borlease Otomotiv, Nurol Varlık Kiralama ve Uşak Seramik tarafından ihraç edilen borçlanma araçlarına ilişkin kupon ve itfa ödemelerinin gerçekleştirilemediğini açıkladı. Ödemelerin, ihraççı kuruluşların gerekli tutarları aktarmaması nedeniyle yapılamadığı bildirildi.

news.titleTr: KAP'ta temerrüt bildirimi: Üç şirketin borç ödemesi gerçekleşmedi
news.summaryTr: Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu (MKK), Borlease Otomotiv, Nurol Varlık Kiralama ve Uşak Seramik tarafından ihraç edilen borçlanma araçlarına ilişkin kupon ve itfa ödemelerinin gerçekleştirilemediğini açıkladı. Ödemelerin, ihraççı kuruluşların gerekli tutarları aktarmaması nedeniyle yapılamadığı bildirildi.
news.articleText: KAP'ta temerrüt bildirimi: Üç şirketin borç ödemesi gerçekleşmedi - Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu (MKK), Borlease Otomotiv, Nurol Varlık Kiralama ve Uşak Seramik tarafından ihraç edilen borçlanma araçlarına ilişkin kupon ve itfa ödemelerinin gerçekleştirilemediğini açıkladı. - Ödemelerin, ihraççı kuruluşların gerekli tutarları aktarmaması nedeniyle yapılamadığı bildirildi. Merkezi Kayıt Kuruluşu A.Ş. tarafından 11 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan bildirimde, üç farklı borçlanma aracına ilişkin ödemelerin gerçekleştirilemediği duyuruldu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle MKK açıklamasına göre, Borlease Otomotiv, Nurol Varlık Kiralama ve Uşak Seramik tarafından ihraç edilen finansal araçların 11 Kasım tarihli ödeme işlemleri, ilgili kuruluşların ödeme tutarlarını aktarmaması nedeniyle MKK aracılığıyla tamamlanamadı. Borlease'in kupon ödemesi yapılamadı Borlease Otomotiv A.Ş. tarafından ihraç edilen TRSBORL22714 ISIN kodlu özel sektör borçlanma aracının 11 Kasım 2026 tarihli kupon ödemesi gerçekleştirilemedi. MKK, ödemenin ihraççı kuruluşun gerekli tutarı aktarmaması nedeniyle yapılamadığını bildirdi. Nurol Varlık Kiralama ve Uşak Seramik'te itfa ve kupon ödemesi aksadı Nurol Varlık Kiralama A.Ş. tarafından ihraç edilen, fon kullanıcısı WorqCompany Dış Ticaret A.Ş. olan TRDNVKAK2631 ISIN kodlu kira sertifikasının 11 Kasım tarihli itfa ve kupon ödemesi de gerçekleştirilemedi. Uşak Seramik Sanayi A.Ş. tarafından ihraç edilen TRFUSAKK2619 ISIN kodlu özel sektör borçlanma aracına ilişkin itfa ve kupon ödemesi de aynı nedenle yapılamadı. MKK, her iki ödeme işleminin de ilgili kuruluşların ödeme tutarlarını aktarmaması nedeniyle tamamlanamadığını açıkladı. Özel sektör borçlanma araçları, şirketlerin finansman sağlamak amacıyla ihraç ettiği ve yatırımcılara belirli dönemlerde faiz veya getiri ödemesi taahhüt ettiği sermaye piyasası araçlarıdır. İtfa, borçlanma aracının vadesinde anaparanın geri ödenmesini ifade eder.

news.titleTr: İstanbul'da 20 ilçenin 2027 bütçesi belli oldu! İşte en fazla bütçeye sahip ilçeler
news.summaryTr: İBB Meclisi'nde 20 ilçenin 2027 bütçesi kabul edildi. Arnavutköy 19,9 milyar TL ile ilk sırada yer alırken Esenyurt 16 milyar TL'lik bütçeyle ikinci oldu. Adalar ise 850 milyon TL ile en düşük bütçeye sahip ilçe oldu.
news.articleText: İstanbul'da 20 ilçenin 2027 bütçesi belli oldu! İşte en fazla bütçeye sahip ilçeler İBB Meclisi'nde 20 ilçenin 2027 bütçesi kabul edildi. Arnavutköy 19,9 milyar TL ile ilk sırada yer alırken Esenyurt 16 milyar TL'lik bütçeyle ikinci oldu. Adalar ise 850 milyon TL ile en düşük bütçeye sahip ilçe oldu. İstanbul'da ilçe belediyelerinin 2027 yılı bütçeleri İBB Meclisi gündemine geldi. İlk oturumda 20 ilçenin bütçesi kabul edilirken, Arnavutköy 19,9 milyar TL ile en yüksek bütçeye sahip ilçe oldu. news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: AB'de Tüketiciyi yanıltan şirketlere küresel cirosunun yüzde 6'sına kadar ceza geliyor
news.summaryTr: AB Komisyonu, internet alışverişlerinde yanıltıcı uygulamaları yasaklayan yeni düzenleme teklif etti. Abonelik iptalleri kolaylaşacak, tüketici haklarını ihlal eden şirketlere küresel cirolarının yüzde 6'sına kadar ceza verilebilecek.
news.articleText: AB'de Tüketiciyi yanıltan şirketlere küresel cirosunun yüzde 6'sına kadar ceza geliyor - AB Komisyonu, internet alışverişlerinde yanıltıcı uygulamaları yasaklayan yeni düzenleme teklif etti. Abonelik iptalleri kolaylaşacak, tüketici haklarını ihlal eden şirketlere küresel cirolarının yüzde 6'sına kadar ceza verilebilecek. Avrupa Birliği (AB), internet alışverişlerinde tüketici haklarını güçlendirmek için yeni bir düzenleme paketi hazırladı. Avrupa Komisyonu'nun teklifine göre tüketicileri yanıltan satış yöntemleri yasaklanacak, abonelik iptalleri kolaylaştırılacak ve kuralları ihlal eden şirketlere küresel yıllık cirolarının yüzde 6'sına kadar para cezası uygulanabilecek. İnternet alışverişlerinde yanıltıcı satış yöntemleri yasaklanacak CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle AB Komisyonu, Dijital Adalet Yasası ve Tüketicinin Korunması İşbirliği Tüzüğü'nün güncellenmesine yönelik tekliflerini açıkladı. Düzenlemeyle internet üzerinden alışveriş yapan tüketicilerin fiziksel mağazalardakiyle aynı düzeyde korunması hedefleniyor. Buna göre, tüketicileri istemedikleri ürünleri satın almaya yönlendiren ve alışveriş kararlarını manipüle eden uygulamalar yasaklanacak. Ürünlerin tükenmek üzere olduğu yönünde gerçeği yansıtmayan uyarılar verilmesi gibi yanıltıcı satış yöntemlerine izin verilmeyecek. Gizli ücretlere ve değişken fiyatlara daha sıkı denetim İnternet alışverişlerinde fiyatlandırmanın daha şeffaf hale getirilmesi planlanıyor. Özellikle video oyunlarında kullanılan sanal para birimleriyle satın alınan ürünlerin gerçek fiyatlarının açıkça gösterilmesi gerekecek. Konser ve spor etkinlikleri gibi alanlarda değişken fiyatlandırma uygulamalarına yönelik şeffaflık da artırılacak. Sanal kuyruklarda bekleyen tüketicilere güncel fiyatın yanı sıra uygulanabilecek en yüksek fiyat da gösterilecek. Dijital oyunlarda çocukların harcamalarına sınırlama Dijital platformlarda kullanıcıları aşırı harcamaya yönlendiren ve bağımlılık oluşturabilecek özelliklerin kapatılmasına imkan tanınacak. Çocukların dijital oyunlarda aşırı harcama yapmasını önlemek amacıyla ödeme karşılığında avantaj veya ilerleme elde edilmesini sağlayan kumar benzeri uygulamalar yasaklanacak. Ayrıca çocukları hedef alan veya hassas kişisel verileri kullanan haksız kişiselleştirilmiş reklam ve fiyatlandırma uygulamalarına sınırlama getirilecek. Fenomenlere reklam açıklama zorunluluğu Sosyal medya fenomenlerinin ücret karşılığında tanıttıkları ürün ve hizmetlerin reklam olduğunu açıkça belirtmeleri zorunlu hale gelecek. Tüketicilere müşteri hizmetlerinde gerçek bir kişiyle iletişim kurma hakkı tanınması da teklifin öne çıkan başlıkları arasında yer alıyor. Yapay zeka aracılarının tüketiciler adına alışveriş yapması durumunda da tüketici haklarının korunması hedefleniyor. Abonelik iptalleri kolaylaşacak Yeni düzenlemeyle dijital aboneliklerin iptal edilmesi kolaylaştırılacak. İstenmeyen otomatik abonelik yenilemeleri ve ücretsiz deneme sürelerinin ücretli aboneliklere dönüşmesiyle ortaya çıkan sorunların önüne geçilmesi amaçlanıyor. Şirketlere küresel cirolarının yüzde 6'sına kadar ceza Teklifteki en dikkat çekici başlıklardan biri de yaptırımlar. Tüketici haklarının geniş çaplı ihlal edildiği durumlarda AB Komisyonuna doğrudan soruşturma açma ve para cezası verme yetkisi tanınması öngörülüyor. Kuralları ihlal eden şirketlere dünya genelindeki yıllık cirolarının yüzde 6'sına kadar para cezası uygulanabilecek. AB dışındaki şirketlerin de tüketici haklarına ilişkin soruşturmalarda yetkililerle işbirliği yapabilmeleri için birlik içinde yasal temsilci bulundurmaları gerekecek. Düzenlemelerin yürürlüğe girmesi için Avrupa Parlamentosu ve AB Konseyi tarafından müzakere edilerek kabul edilmesi gerekiyor.

news.title: Real Madrid'den Arda Güler için 800 milyon euroluk plan: Sözleşme 2035'e uzayabilir
news.summary: Real Madrid'in, PSG ve Bayern Münih'in ilgisini yakından takip ettiği Arda Güler'in sözleşmesini 2035 yılına kadar uzatmayı değerlendirdiği öne sürüldü. İspanyol ekibinin milli futbolcuya zam ve 800 milyon euroluk serbest kalma bedeli içeren bir teklif üzerinde çalıştığı iddia edildi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Real Madrid'den Arda Güler için 800 milyon euroluk plan: Sözleşme 2035'e uzayabilir
news.summaryTr: Real Madrid'in, PSG ve Bayern Münih'in ilgisini yakından takip ettiği Arda Güler'in sözleşmesini 2035 yılına kadar uzatmayı değerlendirdiği öne sürüldü. İspanyol ekibinin milli futbolcuya zam ve 800 milyon euroluk serbest kalma bedeli içeren bir teklif üzerinde çalıştığı iddia edildi.
news.articleText: Real Madrid'den Arda Güler için 800 milyon euroluk plan: Sözleşme 2035'e uzayabilir - Real Madrid'in, PSG ve Bayern Münih'in ilgisini yakından takip ettiği Arda Güler'in sözleşmesini 2035 yılına kadar uzatmayı değerlendirdiği öne sürüldü. - İspanyol ekibinin milli futbolcuya zam ve 800 milyon euroluk serbest kalma bedeli içeren bir teklif üzerinde çalıştığı iddia edildi. Real Madrid, Arda Güler'in geleceğini güvence altına almak için harekete geçmeye hazırlanıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İspanyol basınında yer alan iddialara göre, Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) ve Bayern Münih'in milli futbolcuyla ilgilenmesi, Madrid yönetimini erken bir sözleşme yenileme seçeneğini değerlendirmeye yöneltti. Florentino Perez başkanlığındaki kulübün, takımın gelecek planlarında önemli bir yere sahip gördüğü Arda Güler için kapsamlı bir sözleşme hazırlığında olduğu belirtiliyor. Arda Güler'e 2035'e kadar sözleşme ve 800 milyon euro serbest kalma bedeli Real Madrid'in değerlendirdiği öne sürülen pakette üç önemli başlık bulunuyor: 2035 yılına kadar uzatılacak sözleşme, maaş artışı ve 800 milyon euroluk serbest kalma bedeli. Bernabeu Digital'in haberine göre kulübün bu şartlarla Avrupa'nın büyük takımlarından gelebilecek transfer girişimlerine karşı Arda Güler'i kadrosunda tutmayı hedeflediği ifade ediliyor. Ancak henüz futbolcuya resmi bir teklif sunulmadığı, söz konusu rakamların Real Madrid'in üzerinde çalıştığı olası koşulları yansıttığı belirtiliyor. Arda Güler'in geleceğinde Mourinho'nun rolü belirleyici olacak Arda Güler'in çevresinin, Real Madrid'in olası sözleşme teklifini değerlendirmeye açık olduğu ancak henüz yenileme konusunda karar vermediği ileri sürüldü. Milli futbolcunun, geleceğine ilişkin karar vermeden önce Jose Mourinho yönetimindeki projede nasıl bir rol üstleneceğini görmek istediği iddia ediliyor. Arda'nın takım içindeki etkisinin artması ve Kylian Mbappe ile yakaladığı uyum da dikkat çeken unsurlar arasında gösteriliyor. Real Madrid'in PSG ve Bayern Münih'in olası hamlelerinden önce harekete geçmek istediği belirtilirken, görüşmelerin henüz başlangıç aşamasında olduğu ve taraflar arasında kesinleşmiş bir anlaşma bulunmadığı aktarılıyor. Arda Güler, Real Madrid'e 2023 yılında Fenerbahçe'den transfer oldu. Milli futbolcu, teknik kapasitesi ve hücumdaki yaratıcılığıyla kulübün gelecek planlarında önemli isimlerden biri olarak görülüyor.

news.summary: Borsa İstanbul'da hisse senetleri ve endekslerdeki anlık fiyat hareketleri yatırımcılar tarafından izleniyor. BIST 100 ve BIST 30 endekslerinin seyri, bankacılık ve sanayi hisseleri, günün yükselen ve düşen hisseleri, işlem hacimleri, sektör endeksleri ve VİOP vadeli kontratlarındaki gelişmeler...
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Borsa günü yükselişle kapadı
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da hisse senetleri ve endekslerdeki anlık fiyat hareketleri yatırımcılar tarafından izleniyor. BIST 100 ve BIST 30 endekslerinin seyri, bankacılık ve sanayi hisseleri, günün yükselen ve düşen hisseleri, işlem hacimleri, sektör endeksleri ve VİOP vadeli kontratlarındaki gelişmeler...
news.articleText: Borsa günü yükselişle kapadı - BIST 100 endeksi günü 4,56 puan (%0,04) artışla 11.666,42 puandan tamamladı. BIST 100'de sanayi ve enerji payları prim yarışında öne çıktı. Saat 15:47 itibarıyla piyasa ekranlarına yansıyan anlık verilere göre, endekse dahil olan ve seans içinde en yüksek prim oranlarını yakalayan öne çıkan hisseler şu şekilde sıralandı: Tekfen Holding (TKFEN): Günlük bazda yüzde 8,11 oranında güçlü bir prim yapan hisse, 202,60 TRY seviyesinden işlem görüyor. Bursa Çimento (BTCİM): Yüzde 6,32 oranında değer kazanan hisse, 2,02 TRY seviyesinden alıcı buluyor. Tüpraş (TUPRS): Akaryakıt ve rafineri sektörünün devi yüzde 5,89 artış kaydederek 350,75 TRY seviyesine tırmandı. Aygaz (AYGAZ): Yüzde 4,20 prim yapan hisse, 266,50 TRY son fiyatıyla işlem görüyor. Aksa Enerji (AKSEN): Yüzde 4,06 artışla 71,75 TRY seviyesine yükseldi. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günün ilk yarısında yüzde 1,08 değer kazanarak 11.787,46 puana yükseldi. Endeks, günün ilk yarısında en düşük 11.621,72, en yüksek 11.820,47 puanı gördü. Toplam işlem hacmi 62,5 milyar lira oldu. Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,39, holding endeksi yüzde 0,58 değer kazandı. Sektör endeksleri arasında en çok kazandıran yüzde 4,34 ile kimya petrol plastik, en fazla kaybeden ise yüzde 0,70 ile inşaat oldu. Günün ilk yarısında teknoloji endeksi yüzde 2, sanayi endeksi yüzde 1,89, mali endeks yüzde 0,51 ve hizmetler endeksi yüzde 0,30 değer kazandı. Önceki kapanışa kıyasla günün ilk yarısında BIST 100 endeksine dahil hisselerden 64'ü yükselirken 31'i düştü, 5'i yatay seyretti. En çok işlem gören hisse senetleri, Tüpraş, ASELSAN, Türk Hava Yolları, Koç Holding ile Ereğli Demir Çelik oldu. Borsa İstanbul'da alıcılı seyir güç kazanırken hisse senedi piyasalarında yükseliş ivmesi öne çıktı. BIST 100 ve BIST 30 endeksleri ile VİOP'ta artış yüzde 1'in üzerine çıktı. Borsa İstanbul’un gösterge endeksi BIST 100, 11 Kasım işlem seansının ilk saatlerinde volatil ve yatay-negatif bir izlek sürdürüyor. BIST 100 endeksi, önceki kapanış seviyesine yakın yatay bir denge kurdu. Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, güne yüzde 0,35 yükselişle 11.702,38 puandan başladı. Bankacılık endeksi yüzde 0,22, holding endeksi yüzde 0,31 değer kazandı. Sektör endeksleri arasında en fazla kazandıran yüzde 0,98 ile metal ana sanayi, en çok kaybettiren yüzde 0,31 ile ulaştırma oldu. Dün satış ağırlıklı bir seyir izleyen Borsa İstanbul'da BIST 100 endeksi, günü yüzde 0,43 değer kaybederek 11.661,86 puandan tamamlamıştı. Borsa İstanbul Vadeli İşlem ve Opsiyon Piyasası'nda (VİOP) BIST 30 endeksine dayalı aralık vadeli kontrat güne yüzde 0,17 yükselişle 15.265,00 puandan başladı. Dün satış ağırlıklı seyreden aralık vadeli endeks kontratı, normal seansı yüzde 0,09 azalışla 15.239,00 puandan tamamlamıştı. Endeks kontratı akşam seansında da düşüşünü sürdürerek 15.230,00 puandan işlem gördü. Küresel piyasalar, teknoloji şirketlerine ilişkin iyimserliğe karşın ABD'de beklentilerin üzerinde gelen enflasyon verisinin ABD Merkez Bankasının (Fed) gelecek ay faiz artıracağı yönündeki beklentileri güçlendirmesiyle karışık seyrediyor. Analistler, bugün yurt içinde perakende satışların, yurt dışında ise Almanya'da enflasyon ve Avrupa Merkez Bankası (ECB) Başkanı Christine Lagarde'ın konuşmasının takip edileceğini belirterek, teknik açıdan endeks kontratında 15.400 ve 15.500 puanın direnç, 15.100 ve 15.000 puanın destek konumunda olduğunu kaydetti.

news.title: İkinci el otomobil almak isteyenler dikkat! Yılın en iyi fırsat zamanı açıklandı
news.summary: İkinci el otomobil almak için en avantajlı dönemler açıklandı. iSeeCars araştırmasına göre aralık, uygun fiyatlı araç bulmak için yılın en iyi ayı olurken haziran en dezavantajlı dönem olarak öne çıktı.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: İkinci el otomobil almak isteyenler dikkat! Yılın en iyi fırsat zamanı açıklandı
news.summaryTr: İkinci el otomobil almak için en avantajlı dönemler açıklandı. iSeeCars araştırmasına göre aralık, uygun fiyatlı araç bulmak için yılın en iyi ayı olurken haziran en dezavantajlı dönem olarak öne çıktı.
news.articleText: İkinci el otomobil almak isteyenler dikkat! Yılın en iyi fırsat zamanı açıklandı İkinci el otomobil almak için en avantajlı dönemler açıklandı. iSeeCars araştırmasına göre aralık, uygun fiyatlı araç bulmak için yılın en iyi ayı olurken haziran en dezavantajlı dönem olarak öne çıktı. iSeeCars'ın 42 milyondan fazla ikinci el araç satışını inceleyerek hazırladığı araştırma, otomobil almak için yılın en avantajlı dönemlerini ortaya koydu. Araştırmaya göre kış ayları uygun fiyatlı araç bulmak için öne çıkarken, yaz aylarında fırsatlar belirgin şekilde azalıyor. İşte ikinci el otomobil almak için en avantajlı ve en dezavantajlı dönemler... İkinci el otomobil almak için en iyi ay: Aralık Araştırmaya göre aralık, piyasa değerinin en az yüzde 10 altında fiyatlanan ikinci el otomobilleri bulmak için yılın en avantajlı ayı. Ocak ve kasım ayları da fırsatların yoğunlaştığı dönemler arasında yer alıyor. Şubat ayında ise uygun fiyatlı araç bulma ihtimali yıllık ortalamanın yüzde 28,8 üzerine çıkıyor. Ocak ve kasım aylarında da fırsat var Kış döneminde otomobil almak isteyenler için ocak ve kasım ayları da öne çıkıyor. iSeeCars araştırması, bu aylarda piyasa değerinin altında fiyatlanan araçlarla karşılaşma ihtimalinin diğer birçok döneme kıyasla daha yüksek olduğunu ortaya koyuyor. Şubat ayında fırsat ihtimali yüzde 28,8 artıyor Şubat ayı, ikinci el otomobil alıcıları için avantajlı dönemlerden biri. Araştırmaya göre bu ayda piyasa değerinin en az yüzde 10 altında fiyatlanan araçları bulma ihtimali yıllık ortalamanın yüzde 28,8 üzerinde gerçekleşiyor. Haziran, otomobil almak için en kötü ay Yaz ayları ikinci el otomobil alıcıları açısından daha dezavantajlı. Haziran, fırsat bulmanın en zor olduğu ay olarak öne çıkıyor. Bu dönemde uygun fiyatlı araç fırsatları günlük ortalamanın yüzde 28,8 altında kalıyor. Mayıs ve temmuzda da fırsatlar azalıyor Mayıs ayında piyasa değerinin altında araç bulma fırsatları günlük ortalamanın yüzde 28,2 gerisinde kalıyor. Temmuz ayında ise bu düşüş yüzde 25'e ulaşıyor. Araştırmacılar, havaların ısınmasıyla otomobil talebinin artmasının uygun fiyatlı araç bulmayı zorlaştırdığına dikkat çekiyor. 19 Haziran yılın en dezavantajlı günü Araştırmada gün bazında yapılan değerlendirmede 19 Haziran, ikinci el otomobil almak için yılın en elverişsiz günü olarak belirlendi. Bu tarihte fırsat bulma ihtimali günlük ortalamanın yüzde 30,7 altında kaldı. Anma Günü ve Babalar Günü de araştırmada alıcılar açısından fırsatların sınırlı olduğu dönemler arasında gösterildi. Araştırma 42 milyondan fazla araç satışını kapsıyor iSeeCars, 2025 yılından Ekim 2026'ya kadar gerçekleşen 42 milyondan fazla ikinci el araç satışını inceledi. Araştırmada piyasa değerinin en az yüzde 10 altında listelenen otomobiller fırsat olarak tanımlandı. Genel ortalamada herhangi bir günde böyle bir araç bulma ihtimali yüzde 11,5 olarak hesaplandı.

news.title: PlayStation 5'te 100 milyon barajı aşıldı: PS4 rekoru hedefte
news.summary: Sony'nin güncel verilerine göre PlayStation 5'in satış kanallarına gönderilen toplam konsol sayısı 100 milyonu geçti. Lansmanından yaklaşık 6 yıl sonra bu kilometre taşına ulaşan PS5'in satışları ise son çeyrekte geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre geriledi.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: PlayStation 5'te 100 milyon barajı aşıldı: PS4 rekoru hedefte
news.summaryTr: Sony'nin güncel verilerine göre PlayStation 5'in satış kanallarına gönderilen toplam konsol sayısı 100 milyonu geçti. Lansmanından yaklaşık 6 yıl sonra bu kilometre taşına ulaşan PS5'in satışları ise son çeyrekte geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre geriledi.
news.articleText: PlayStation 5'te 100 milyon barajı aşıldı: PS4 rekoru hedefte - Sony'nin güncel verilerine göre PlayStation 5'in satış kanallarına gönderilen toplam konsol sayısı 100 milyonu geçti. - Lansmanından yaklaşık 6 yıl sonra bu kilometre taşına ulaşan PS5'in satışları ise son çeyrekte geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre geriledi. Sony, PlayStation 5'in toplam satışlarının 10 Kasım itibarıyla 100 milyon adedi aştığını açıkladı. Böylece konsol, Kasım 2020'deki lansmanından yaklaşık 6 yıl sonra önemli bir eşiği geride bıraktı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Açıklanan rakam, tüketicilere satılan konsolları değil, perakendecilere gönderilen ürünleri ifade eden sell-in verilerine dayanıyor. Bu nedenle kullanıcıların elindeki PS5 sayısı 100 milyonun altında bulunuyor. PS5, bu rakamla PlayStation 4'ün 117 milyon adetlik satış seviyesine yaklaşırken, 102,4 milyon adetlik satışa ulaşan ilk PlayStation modelinin de neredeyse yakınına geldi. PS5 satışlarında gerileme yaşanıyor 100 milyonluk eşik önemli bir başarı olsa da Sony'nin verileri konsol satışlarında düşüş yaşandığını gösteriyor. Sony'nin 2026 mali yılının ikinci çeyreğinde (Q2) 2,6 milyon PS5 konsolu sevk edildi. Bu rakam, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 4 milyon adetlik seviyenin belirgin şekilde altında kaldı. Böylece PS5'in lansmanından bu yana kaydedilen en düşük ikinci çeyrek satış rakamına ulaşıldı. Buna karşın ikinci çeyrekteki 2,6 milyon adetlik satış, mali yılın ilk çeyreğindeki 1,6 milyonluk seviyenin üzerinde gerçekleşti. İlk çeyrek, PS5'in lansmanından bu yana tek çeyrekte kaydedilen en düşük ikinci satış rakamı olmuştu. En düşük seviye ise 2025 mali yılının dördüncü çeyreğinde görülen 1,5 milyon adet olarak kayıtlara geçmişti. news.titleTr: Google'dan Türkiye'deki reklam verenlere indirim! 2027'de yarı yarıya düşebilir
news.summaryTr: Google, Türkiye'deki reklam verenlerden aldığı yüzde 4,5'lik ek ücreti 1 Ocak 2027'de düşürmeye hazırlanıyor. Yeni oran konusunda şirketin e-postasında yüzde 2,25, resmî destek sayfasında ise yüzde 2,5 bilgisi yer alıyor.
news.articleText: Google'dan Türkiye'deki reklam verenlere indirim! 2027'de yarı yarıya düşebilir - Google, Türkiye'deki reklam verenlerden aldığı yüzde 4,5'lik ek ücreti 1 Ocak 2027'de düşürmeye hazırlanıyor. Yeni oran konusunda şirketin e-postasında yüzde 2,25, resmî destek sayfasında ise yüzde 2,5 bilgisi yer alıyor. Google, Türkiye'deki reklam verenlerden aldığı Yasal İşletim Maliyeti ek ücretini 1 Ocak 2027 itibarıyla düşürmeye hazırlanıyor. Google Ads ve YouTube reklam faturalarına yansıtılan yüzde 4,5'lik mevcut oranın yüzde 2,25 veya yüzde 2,5'e indirilmesi gündemde. Ancak şirketin gönderdiği e-posta ile resmî destek sayfasında farklı oranlar yer alıyor. Google'dan Türkiye tarifesinde indirim CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Google Payments aracılığıyla reklam verenlere gönderilen bilgilendirme e-postasında, Türkiye'deki Yasal İşletim Maliyeti oranının 1 Ocak 2027'den itibaren yüzde 4,5'ten yüzde 2,25'e düşürüleceği belirtildi. Buna karşılık Google'ın resmî destek dokümanında yeni oran yüzde 2,5 olarak açıklandı. İki farklı bilgilendirme nedeniyle 2027'de uygulanacak kesin oran henüz netlik kazanmadı. Düzenleme Google Ads, YouTube Rezervasyonu ve Display & Video 360 platformlarını kapsıyor. Yeni tarife, 1 Ocak 2027'den sonra gerçekleştirilen reklam harcamalarının faturalarına veya hesap özetlerine yansıtılacak. Fransa ve İtalya'da ek ücret artıyor Google'ın tarife güncellemesi yalnızca Türkiye'yi kapsamıyor. Şirket, Türkiye'de ek ücreti düşürmeye hazırlanırken Fransa ve İtalya'da oranları artıracak. 1 Ocak 2027 itibarıyla Fransa'da yüzde 2 olan ek ücret yüzde 3'e, İtalya'da yüzde 2,5 olan oran ise yüzde 3'e çıkarılacak. Diğer bazı ülkelerde mevcut oranlar korunacak. Google, İspanya'da yüzde 3, Avusturya'da yüzde 5 ve Birleşik Krallık'ta yüzde 2 oranında Yasal İşletim Maliyeti uyguluyor. Şirket daha önce Hindistan'daki yüzde 2'lik ek ücreti 1 Eylül 2024'te, Kanada'daki yüzde 2,5'lik kesintiyi ise 2025 yılında tamamen kaldırmıştı.

news.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
news.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
news.summaryTr: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.
news.articleText: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough - Published Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day. Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs to end the nearly five year-long war sparked by Russia's invasion. Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest." "I believe the Russians came with very strict directives, so it was extremely difficult to soften the discussion," he said. But he added that he felt "good momentum" and urged for a second round of talks to be organised as soon as possible. Both Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a large-scale prisoner of war exchange was in the works and could be carried out soon. After the talks it was announced that on Thursday US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner - President Donald Trump's son-in-law - would travel to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, and then to Dublin to speak to Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky. This latest round of talks had been framed as centred around the "security architecture" of Europe. For Kyiv, this may include reassurances that allies will come to its aid if Ukraine comes under attack again, despite the country not being a Nato member. For Moscow, it is likely to include a limit to the influence of Nato in eastern Europe - a central concern for the Kremlin since the alliance's eastward expansion. Earlier this week Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while Kremlin negotiator Vladimir Medinsky said the world needed a "new" and "fair" security system. Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin. Representatives of Britain, Nato and various EU countries were also in Abu Dhabi and met with US and Ukrainian negotiators, but the Kremlin - with whom the EU does not officially communicate - said its delegation had not had any contact with them. Moscow has been dismissive of European involvement, although Europeans have long argued that they are central to any post-war dynamics on their continent. Many - particularly in eastern Europe - feel their security is linked to that of Ukraine. Agreements cannot be implemented "if no consensus can be reached among Nato members," a German government spokesperson said on Wednesday. Kushner said the US was keen to bring the Europeans on board and said that getting them "added to the format" would be on the agenda for his talks with Putin. There is also disagreement on whether discussions on a future security framework should be preceded by a ceasefire, as the Europeans and Kyiv would want, or whether the fighting only stops after an agreement has been reached, as the Kremlin has insisted. Any agreement on a peacetime security framework, however, is contingent on the war ending, Kushner noted. But that cannot occur "until there's an agreement on territory and on all other bilateral issues," he added. Since talks began last year, a core obstacle to any settlement has been Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia. Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas. This matter was the "hardest", Kushner acknowledged, while Zelensky's chief of staff and negotiator Kyrylo Budanov refused to be drawn on whether Russia was still demanding a Ukrainian withdrawal from the region. "These deals are very hard and complex, and this one is very emotional, very complex," Kushner said. "The reality is there is no trust right now between the sides and that is to be expected after a conflict like this." Related topics - Published1 day ago - Published19 hours ago

news.title: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
news.summary: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony
news.summaryTr: Leonardo Bertulazzi, a former member of the Marxist guerrilla group the Red Brigades, was about to be extradited to his home country of Italy.
news.articleText: Kidnapper, 74, escapes from house arrest in Argentina by abseiling from balcony - Published A 74-year-old Italian man who was found guilty of a kidnapping carried out by a far-left militant group in the 1970s has escaped while under house arrest in Argentina and is on the run. Leonardo Bertulazzi used a harness to abseil down from a fifth-floor balcony in the capital, Buenos Aires. His escape was not immediately registered because he had tampered with his electronic ankle monitor so that it continued to transmit body temperature measurements even after he had prised it open and absconded. Bertulazzi already spent decades as a fugitive after he was sentenced in absentia in Italy for the 1977 kidnapping of Italian naval engineer Pietro Costa. He was awaiting extradition to Italy and was being monitored by the Argentine ministry of security through an ankle tag which registers the wearer's body temperature and movements. Officials said that they had become suspicious when they noticed that the tag had remained stationary. When they entered the fifth-floor apartment in the centre of Buenos Aires, Bertulazzi was gone, but the ankle monitor remained. Wary of Bertulazzi's past with the Marxist guerilla group the Red Brigades and his bomb-making skills, police called in explosives experts in case it had been rigged to detonate, according to Argentine newspaper Clarín. However, the experts found that while Bertulazzi had tampered with the device, he had done so to prevent the alarm from sounding once he removed it. A nationwide manhunt is now under way. Italian media say that his extradition to Italy had been imminent after his last appeal was rejected. Bertulazzi was first arrested after using a false passport to cross into Argentina from neighbouring Chile in 2002. However, he was granted refugee status in 2004 and lived freely in the South American country until his re-arrest in 2024, when the current right-wing president, Javier Milei, took office. Milei's government said at the time that "Bertulazzi is responsible for crimes that undermined democratic values and the lives of many victims". He was a member of the Red Brigades, which kidnapped and killed a number of state officials in the 1970s and '80s. Bertulazzi was part of the Red Brigades' Genoa section that kidnapped Pietro Costa on the street and then held him for 81 days before receiving a big ransom. The money it made from the kidnapping was then used to buy a flat in Rome, which was used in 1978 for the Red Brigades' most notorious crime, the kidnap and murder of Italian former Prime Minister, Aldo Moro. Moro was abducted when his car was ambushed on the way to the opening of parliament. He was held in the flat for 54 days before he was shot and his body abandoned in the boot of a Renault car in the centre of Rome. news.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
news.summary: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

news.titleTr: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
news.summaryTr: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.
news.articleText: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years - Published Transport and other public services across Spain have faced serious disruption in the first general strike for 14 years called by the main unions over housing and the high cost of living. Demonstrations were also planned later on Wednesday, with the biggest protests expected in Madrid and Barcelona. Spaniards are due to vote in parliamentary elections on 29 November. The head of the big UGT labour union, Pepe Álvarez, said the strike was a success with "massive" participation, while Unai Sordo of the CC OO union said turnout was "very significant." However, the Spanish Confederation of Business Organisations said participation was "low and uneven", depending on the areas and sectors involved. Some of the biggest disruption on Wednesday was seen in the main industrial hubs of Madrid and the north-eastern region of Catalonia where traffic was halted on several main roads. The interior ministry said dozens of people were arrested for a variety of incidents and Spanish reports said estate agencies had seen attacks on their offices. The strike was triggered by widespread protests over affordable housing and rising living costs, after the eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from a flat in Madrid where she had lived for seven decades. She died in hospital weeks later. Rental prices in the capital have soared in recent years. The monthly cost of a 50m sq apartment in Madrid was an average of €1,170 in October, according to property portal Idealista, while Spain's average gross monthly salary is about €2,460 (£2,056). That amounts to nearly half the average gross salary, well above the 30% level of affordability often recommended by housing experts and public institutions. Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez called snap elections last month after parliament failed to approve his plan for housing reform. Not since 2012, under the conservative government of Mariano Rajoy, has Spain held general strikes. And while previous strikes have been problematic for the government in power, this one is different. Sánchez and his ministers have even encouraged workers to down tools and demand affordable housing. "Your eight-hour day. Your pension. Your public healthcare… These were collective conquests," he wrote on social media, praising those who took part in previous strikes. PP leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo called the general strike "nonsense", calling the unions "mafia" and "trash". Feijoo's party is leading in the polls and party spokesman Miguel Tellado accused the government of exploiting the strike to warn voters against allowing a right-wing government to be formed, which looks the most likely outcome of the 29 November election. Sánchez told Spanish TV this week: "What is nonsense is to question the rights of workers to strike." Among those taking part in the general strike was Gonzalo Álvarez, 27, who was visiting different picket lines in central Madrid. Although he works in sales, he has been volunteering for a housing union that tries to protect tenants and makes them aware of their rights. The eviction of Maricarmen Abascal at the end of September "was the little fire" that sparked this protest, he told the BBC. Álvarez knew the 87-year-old, who had faced a tripling of her rent under new landlords, and says he was deeply upset by her treatment. He rents a small, one-bedroom flat with his girlfriend, a dental hygienist, in the city's southern Arganzuela disrict. The couple pay €1,000 between them, which means each spends about half of their salary on housing, even before other bills. "It's absolutely crazy… with the food, with the electricity, with the water, with gas." He sees no way of getting on the property ladder: "You have to collect an insane amount of money to be able to buy a house. So with these salaries, it's impossible." With current rent and purchase prices, he believes buying somewhere is "completely impossible". However, the vice-president of the CEOE, Spanish biggest business association, Miguel Garrido, criticised the strike, complaining that businesses had little to do with the price of housing. "This is not a strike for labour-related reasons, but rather for political ones, and it is closely linked to the early calling of elections," he said. Demonstrations were planned for some of Spain's biggest cities later in the day and the scale of support will be widely viewed as an indicator of public discontent ahead of the election. Another reliable indicator of support for strikes is the level of demand for electricity with Spain's industrial sector. Power usage in Spain fell by 7.5% during the early hours of Wednesday, according to data from operator Red Eléctrica. During the last general strike 14 years ago, equivalent consumption was down by more than 15%.

news.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

news.titleTr: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
news.summaryTr: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
news.articleText: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys. Germany’s largest lender, Deutsche Bank, launched its crypto custody service for institutional and corporate clients on Wednesday, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. The bank also signed a memorandum of understanding with Deutsche Asset Management, its majority-owned asset manager, to explore collaboration on tokenized money market funds, crypto asset exchange-traded commodities and stablecoins. Deutsche Bank announced plans to offer the service to institutional and corporate clients in Europe on Sept. 16, pending regulatory clearance. Deutsche Bank’s listing for crypto custody and transfer services in the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) register is dated Oct. 12 and names Germany’s BaFin as its regulator. The service initially supports Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH) and select stablecoins, including Circle’s USDC (USDC) and EURC (EURC), as well as AllUnity EURAU. Gerald Podobnik, co-head of Deutsche Bank’s corporate bank, told Reuters in October that the bank planned to launch in Germany before expanding to Asian financial centers in 2027. Deutsche Bank partnered with crypto infrastructure provider Taurus in 2023 to develop custody services after applying for a digital asset custody license in Germany. Related: Deutsche Bank-backed AllUnity launches Swiss franc stablecoin CHFAU

news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Barclays’ BlackRock Bitcoin ETF holdings rose 48% in the third quarter, pro-crypto lawmaker Tom Emmer was elected House Republican minority whip as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and hotter-than-expected US inflation raised concerns about a potential half-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings Barclays reported holding 3.94 million shares in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) at the end of the third quarter, up 48% from the previous quarter. The position in the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) was worth about $187 million on Sept. 30, up from $88.5 million for 2.66 million shares on June 30, according to Barclays’ Friday Form 13F filing. “Early readings suggest longer-term holders make up a growing share of the spot bitcoin ETF investor base,” Bitwise analyst Camran Khosravi told Cointelegraph, pointing to increased bank exposure, including at Citigroup. Citigroup reported a new position worth about $119 million in the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC). Its reported IBIT holdings also rose 50% to about 521,000 shares, from 347,000 at the end of June. The filings offer an early indication of changing institutional Bitcoin ETF ownership, with more major banks and hedge funds yet to disclose their third-quarter positions. Institutional investment managers have until Monday to file their third-quarter holdings reports. Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip Pro-crypto US Representative Tom Emmer has been elected House Republican minority whip, securing the party’s second-highest leadership position as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January. Emmer beat Texas Representative August Pfluger in a 103-76 secret ballot vote, according to Politico. He previously served as House Republican majority whip and will remain the party’s No. 2 leader, this time under incoming Minority Leader Jim Jordan. As minority whip, Emmer will be responsible for rallying Republican votes, coordinating the party’s legislative strategy and helping maintain unity on key bills. “Tom has been one of the strongest advocates for digital assets in Congress, and he has led the fight against a government-controlled CBDC and stood up for American innovators,” GOP Senator Cynthia Lummis said on X. Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December Crypto industry experts warned on Tuesday that higher-than-expected US inflation could lead to a another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, making borrowing more expensive and potentially discouraging investment in cryptocurrencies. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month over month in October, above economists’ forecast of 0.3%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics - a slower increase than September’s 0.6% rise. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the expected 0.2%. Currently, the Federal Reserve holds its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%, after raising it by a quarter-point in September and leaving it unchanged in October. The report came just a few hours after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that another core inflation reading of 0.3% or higher could prompt the Fed to consider a larger interest rate hike in December. “In that case, I believe a 50-basis-point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting,” Waller said. “Hiking only 25-basis-points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.”

news.summary: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

news.titleTr: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
news.summaryTr: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
news.articleText: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline. The collapse of Paraguay’s digital lender Ueno Bank last week left nearly three million customers — roughly 60% of Paraguay’s adults — unable to access their accounts. Paraguay’s Central Bank placed Ueno into resolution on Nov. 3 after its solvency ratio fell below half the legally required minimum. An investigation uncovered questionable lending practices and deficiencies in credit documentation and accounting. The collapse also triggered a political crisis, with thousands taking to the streets to protest and President Santiago Peña attempting to resign before being impeached and arrested on charges of breach of trust and using his office for personal gain. Paraguay’s peer-to-peer crypto market immediately reflected the turmoil, with some sellers asking for a USDt premium of up to 13%. “USDt is a lifeline for hundreds millions of people in the world,” Tether chief executive Paolo Ardoino said. For many, the incident sparked uncertainty over savings, wages and the money needed to cover everyday expenses. With the local guaraní (PYG) currency falling 12.3% in a week, some turned to stablecoins to maintain the value of their funds, or just to keep payments moving along. David Eisenmann, founder and chief executive of Paraguayan crypto exchange X4T, tells Magazine the timing made the liquidity need even more pronounced. “The intervention came in the first days of the month,” he says, “exactly when salaries, rent and supplier invoices are due,” adding that many business owners “couldn’t make payroll.” For some, USDt was “suddenly the most liquid money” they had: “This week they learned that having an account isn’t the same as having access to your money.” But beyond another TradFi masterclass in the virtues of self-custody, Ueno’s collapse highlights the growing role of dollar-pegged stablecoins providing an alternative source of liquidity when traditional banks fail. Crypto as a source of liquidity Eisenmann says X4T processed more than $10 million in local on-ramp volume over the 30 days to early November, but some of that activity predated Ueno’s collapse. “The dollar began recovering against the guaraní in October,” he says, “and the Ueno news sped up a move that was already underway.” Related: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed He says the activity “runs in both directions,” with some customers selling crypto for guaraníes or dollars to cover payments they could no longer make through Ueno, while “demand for USDt and USDC as a dollar store of value has risen sharply.” Paraguay’s Central Bank placed Ueno into resolution on Nov. 3. Source: Central Bank of Paraguay As of Nov. 9 the Central Bank said 93.1% of customers with Ueno deposits had been repaid. Despite this confidence has been shaken and X4T continued to see higher online inquiries for dollar-denominated stablecoins. In fact, Eisenmann says the level “has not changed significantly” from the week of the collapse. Rhys Hicks, associate analyst at data and analytics company GlobalData, says the digital bank’s failure has shown “how much can go wrong when governance does not keep pace with growth.” That said, he’s not seeing evidence of a mass migration from Paraguayan banks into stablecoins, since other banks “picked up the slack,” and people “seem to have been angrier” with the government than with the banks. “Some consumers will look for different ways to keep their money safe, but I do not see an overwhelming shift to stablecoins yet,” he says. An old impulse, with new rails Seeking dollars when confidence in domestic banks falters is hardly new. In Argentina’s 2001 financial crisis, the government imposed the “corralito,” restricting cash withdrawals from bank accounts, following a run on deposits. Related: Peter Thiel backs crypto-friendly Silicon Valley Bank rival — Report Amid a deepening crisis over the country’s currency peg and sovereign debt, the government later converted dollar-denominated deposits into pesos, reducing people’s savings by about 30% overnight and further damaging confidence in the country’s fraying banking system. Tether CEO calls USDt a lifeline. Source: Paolo Ardoino But stablecoins aren’t decentralized and they are not insulated from the banking system either. During the March 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, stablecoin issuer Circle disclosed that $3.3 billion of USDC reserves, around 8% of the total, were held at the lender. USDC briefly depegged and fell to 86 cents on secondary markets after Circle said it could not withdraw the funds. A BIS paper on stablecoins and the international monetary system warns that widespread use of dollar-backed tokens could create challenges for monetary sovereignty in emerging markets. Hicks says stablecoins can provide an alternative during periods of political instability and “low trust in the local system” because they are pegged to a more stable currency, like the US dollar. But regulators need to address “transparency” and “consumer protection,” he says, because stablecoin holders don’t benefit from the same deposit guarantees as bank customers, and there is no central bank to step in and make them whole. Eisenmann says he expects the incident to spark more “diversification,” with people “spreading their money across banks, cash and digital assets” instead of relying on a single institution. “How quickly trust in the banks returns will depend on how quickly and transparently the authorities handle the resolution,” he says. news.summary: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

news.titleTr: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
news.summaryTr: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.
news.articleText: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs. This is Part 5 in the technical article series about Bitcoin covenants by Cointelegraph Research. To read the previous article click here. MATT (Merkleize All The Things) is a smart contract framework for Bitcoin that enables stateful contracts and scalable fraud proofs. A stateful contract carries information forward across multiple transactions and can update this information as the contract evolves. Standard Bitcoin scripts do not provide this capability, because each transaction is evaluated independently with no memory of previous executions. Every covenant proposal allows state-carrying UTXOs to an extent, as illustrated by scripting languages such as Sapio, which builds on OP_CTV. This works by using addresses to represent a finite state automaton, where transactions function as the state transitions. However, there is no way to elegantly implement numerical logic in this paradigm, a gap filled by MATT, and in particular its proposed implementation through OP_CCV. Because MATT allows committed data to be computed at spend time and re-embedded into the next output, each spend can derive a new state dynamically, instead of choosing from a predetermined set of states. How OP_CCV commits state into a Taproot key To understand the MATT proposal, it is useful to first review how Taproot commits data through public keys. Every Taproot output contains a base public key, called the internal key, which can be cryptographically modified or “tweaked” to commit to extra information. Formally, the tweaked public key is Q = P + t·G, where P is the internal key, G is the generator of the secp256k1 elliptic curve, and t is a tagged hash of P and the committed data. In a regular Taproot output, this commitment typically encodes the Merkle root of a taptree, which contains hidden spending paths. MATT builds on this mechanism to also embed contract state into the key. Instead of embedding complex logic directly in Bitcoin’s scripting language, MATT encodes computation as a sequence of state commitments, and the chain verifies only that each state transition is valid. MATT can be realized through different opcode combinations. The most direct and well-specified implementation relies on OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY (OP_CCV). OP_CCV provides the primitive that makes state-carrying UTXOs feasible within Taproot. OP_CCV allows a script to verify that a Taproot input or output key has been tweaked to commit to a specific piece of state data. The internal key is first tweaked with a hash of the contract’s current state, and then Taproot’s standard taptree tweak is applied on top. The resulting output key therefore commits to both the tapscript (the set of spending conditions) and the current state of the contract. OP_CCV can then enforce what state is carried forward into the next output. It allows the script to inspect the state data provided on the witness stack, perform computations on it, and require that the resulting updated state is correctly re-committed in a specified output. This is how state transitions are enforced on-chain. The stack format is: OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY The opcode supports three modes for checking an output as well as a separate input mode. In default mode, the entire BTC value of the input UTXO is allocated to the specified output; in deduct mode, only a portion equal to the output’s amount is assigned, leaving the remainder available for further outputs; and in ignore mode, the script and data commitment are verified without constraining the amount. Because default and deduct modes are designed to preserve value across checked outputs, transaction fees must be paid through separate fee-paying inputs. A dedicated fee input and change output can be added to the transaction without conflicting with the covenant’s constraints. This prevents the accidental burning of funds that can occur in more primitive covenant implementations, such as OP_CTV or SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT. It also addresses a major limitation of presigned-transaction-style covenants, which typically define amounts upfront and therefore cannot accommodate dynamic fee adjustments or partial unvaults. OP_CCV + OP_CAT: Merkle Proofs and Fraud Proofs When OP_CCV is combined with OP_CAT, the full MATT framework becomes even more expressive. OP_CAT enables byte concatenation in Script, which makes it possible to construct and verify Merkle proofs directly on-chain. Two distinct Merkle trees are associated with a Taproot output in such an arrangement. The first is the familiar Taproot script tree (the taptree), whose leaves are the contract’s spending scripts. The second is a separate state tree, whose leaves are the contract’s data, such as the intermediate steps of a computation. The OP_CCV + OP_CAT script can verify a Merkle proof against the current state tree root, compute the updated root after a transition, and use OP_CCV to force the next output to commit to it. This construction enables fraud-proof systems with a slashing condition in which a long computation is committed off-chain, and only the specific disputed step (with its path in the binary tree) needs to be revealed and verified on-chain. Similar systems exist as optimistic rollups on other blockchain systems: the full computation runs off-chain, and the on-chain contract only intervenes when someone raises a challenge. Fraud proofs require that the computation be compiled down to a binary circuit or equivalent step-by-step representation that can be committed to in a Merkle tree. OP_CCV + OP_CAT would avoid the need for the Lamport one-time signatures and pre-signed transaction graphs that BitVM relies on to enforce state consistency. Beyond fraud proofs, the OP_CCV and OP_CAT combination also has implications for vaults. OP_CCV alone can implement vaults, but when combined with OP_CAT, it allows fully featured vaults that are essentially equivalent to the functionality proposed by OP_VAULT. As James O’Beirne, the author of OP_VAULT, has noted, OP_CCV represents a more general and robust design that effectively supersedes his earlier proposal. In the next article in this series, we will move on from general covenant proposals to review application-specific opcodes such as OP_VAULT, OP_UNVAULT, and OP_EVICT. Each of the opcodes are designed to solve a specific problem rather than provide broad programmability. Magazine: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

news.summary: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.

news.titleTr: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom'
news.summaryTr: Mada Masr editor-in-chief Lina Attalah is being tried on the charge of "publishing false news" and potentially faces imprisonment.
news.articleText: Egyptian journalist's retrial adjourned as UN warns of 'assaults on press freedom' - Published A criminal court in Cairo has postponed the retrial of the prominent Egyptian journalist Lina Attalah, whose case has drawn international condemnation. Wednesday's opening hearing was adjourned until 18 November after defence lawyers representing the editor-in-chief of the news outlet Mada Masr requested a new judge. The UN has warned of "widening assaults on press freedom by Egyptian authorities, including the targeting, persecution and harassment of independent journalists". Attalah told the BBC that a recent crackdown was meant to "send a chilling message" to "the very few newsrooms that are left". She warned: "Everybody should be careful, everybody should be scared, everybody should be wondering if they are next." Set up 13 years ago, Mada Masr became Egypt's leading independent news site with Attalah as its editor-in-chief and co-founder. Last month, the New Cairo Misdemeanours Court convicted her of running a website without a licence - which she said she had tried in vain for years to obtain. She was issued a hefty fine of 3 million Egyptian pounds ($56,000; £42,000) and Mada Masr was ordered to shut down. After that trial, Attalah found that a court had previously given her a one-year prison sentence, without her knowledge, for "spreading false news" - a charge often used against journalists and dissidents - as well as operating a website without a licence. It was issued in absentia in 2024, even though she was in the country at the time. Attalah is now being retried in that case by the same judge. At the opening session, Attalah's defence team requested the judge's recusal, arguing that he had "already formed a conviction in mind against the defendant", Mada Masr cited its lawyer Hassan al-Azhar as saying, external. The judge went into recess before adjourning proceedings for a week to allow the court to consider the defence's request, he added. Mada Masr also said Attalah's appeal against last month's conviction was scheduled to take place on 25 November. Egypt has largely stifled freedom of the press, ranking 169th out of 180 countries for press freedom, according to Reporters Without Borders' 2026 analysis. The group says that at least 26 journalists who were arrested in recent years remain in detention. While most newspapers and television stations now keep to government lines, Mada Masr remained a rare, independent and investigative news source in Egypt. However, since 2017 the site could only be viewed from outside the country. It had reported on alleged corruption and human rights abuses, and provided deep coverage of politics and economics, as well as regional upheaval and wars in Libya, Sudan and Gaza. In her BBC interview on Sunday, Attalah insisted that the factual reporting and professional standards of Mada Masr had an important role to play in Egyptian society, which could benefit the government. "It's much better if you have a little space left to have it open for professional media organisations who do rigorous reporting, because if we disappear, then you make the space for conspiracies and disinformation," she said. "People need to know, people need to consume information and you're shooting yourself in the foot if you're killing the newsrooms that do it properly." In September, six journalists with the independent fact-checking platform, Matsda2sh - constituting its entire newsroom - were arrested in home raids by the Egyptian authorities and held incommunicado for nearly a week. They have since been charged with joining the Muslim Brotherhood and financing terrorism, and their lawyers report that several were beaten and electrocuted in detention. They say that no evidence has been presented linking them to the Brotherhood. Egypt's former president Mohammed Morsi – who was backed by the Muslim Brotherhood – was removed from power by the military, led by Abdul Fattah al-Sisi, in July 2013 after widespread protests. Under Sisi, who became president the following year, the Islamist movement was classed as a terrorist organisation, leading to a widespread clampdown. On Tuesday, a spokesperson for the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Thameen Al-Kheetan, called for the Matsda2sh reporters to be released, with all charges dropped. He also said the case against Attalah "raises fresh concerns regarding due process and fair trial". "We call on Egypt to end all forms of harassment of journalists and media outlets, and to respect and fulfil the right to freedom of expression, including the right to information," Al-Kheetan said. "The steps taken to suppress the continued work of both Matsda2sh and Mada Masr must be overturned. The people of Egypt have a right to read and hear views expressed through these fora on issues of legitimate public concern." Attalah has suggested the authorities might again be trying to silence independent voices at a time of economic strain in Egypt and regional instability. It has been widely noted that recent legal action against journalists comes after the US State Department waived human rights conditions on $320m (£240m) in its foreign military funding for Egypt in September. This allowed the funds to be released as part of Washington's annual $1.3bn military aid package. The BBC asked US Secretary of State Marco Rubio whether he had raised the recent crackdown on independent journalism with Egypt's Foreign Minister, Badr Abdelatty, at their meeting about regional tensions in Paris on Monday. "We didn't discuss it today," Rubio said. "But… like anything else in foreign policy, there's always a balancing act to further the national interest of the United States. And in the end, Egypt has been a reliable and good defence partner of the United States." "That doesn't mean you agree with everything another government does," he went on, adding that he was not "opining about their journalists". news.title: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
news.summary: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.

news.titleTr: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter
news.summaryTr: The sow and her three cubs were responsible for killing Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, earlier this month.
news.articleText: Four grizzly bears killed in Canada after fatal attack on mother and daughter - Published Four grizzly bears have been killed in connection with a fatal attack on a mother and daughter in the Canadian province of British Columbia. Jennifer Balcarras, 48, and her daughter Selah Reed, 20, died earlier this month after going on an afternoon walk in a trail area in Bella Coola. The British Columbia Conservation Office Service (BCCOS) launched an investigation into their deaths and forensic testing has since confirmed a sow and her three cubs were responsible for the attack. All four were destroyed "in accordance with provincial human-wildlife conflict response guidelines" to protect the public, BCCOS Inspector Jeff Tyre said in an update on Tuesday. - Mother and daughter die after suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada - Published6 days ago "Evidence from the investigation as well as animal DNA was analysed and conclusively linked to a sow and its three offspring," he added. The attack "likely involved predatory behaviour", which Tyre said was "very rare". He added that more than a dozen conservation officers took part in the investigation over the past week, amid "difficult terrain and weather". Balcarras and Reed were "two peas in a pod" who "got along really, really well" and shared many hobbies, Balcarras' brother, Josh, told CBC. "When Jenny hiked, Selah was right there beside her," he said. Tyre said DNA testing also confirmed the four bears were not involved in a 2025 attack on a school group also in the Bella Coola area. The incident in November of last year saw 11 people injured, two of them critically, while the bear responsible was never found. "Today, we have learned from the BC Conservation Officer Service members that they have captured and euthanized the bears involved in the recent fatal attack," said Samuel Schooner, Elected Chief of the Nuxalk Nation, in a statement. "We would like to thank the BC Conservation Officer Service for their dedication and hard work to resolve this incident. This attack has been deeply re-triggering for our community members as we continue to recover from last year's attack. Our thoughts remain with the victims' families."

news.summary: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

news.titleTr: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
news.summaryTr: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.
news.articleText: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion. CoreWeave shares jumped 15.27% in premarket trading Wednesday after the AI cloud provider reported third-quarter revenue that beat analyst estimates. The shares traded at $56.12 as of 12:50 pm UTC, trimming the stock’s year-to-date decline to 32%, according to Yahoo Finance. CoreWeave reported $3.66 billion in third-quarter revenue after the market closed on Tuesday, up 168% from $1.36 billion a year earlier. Revenue came in about 3.4% above the $3.54 billion consensus estimate compiled by Google Finance. The company also reported a revenue backlog of about $132.5 billion as of Sept. 30. The figure includes revenue CoreWeave expects to recognize under existing customer contracts, subject to delivery and service availability. In April, CoreWeave announced a multiyear agreement with AI developer Anthropic to provide computing capacity for its Claude models. Days later, CoreWeave signed a $6 billion deal with quantitative trading company Jane Street to supply cloud infrastructure for trading and research. CoreWeave started as a crypto miner and began shifting to AI infrastructure in 2019. Related: CoreWeave shows how crypto-era infrastructure quietly became AI’s backbone

news.titleTr: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status
news.summaryTr: The country begins a 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free, provided no new cases are recorded.
news.articleText: Kenya discharges last Ebola patient in major milestone towards virus-free status - Published Kenya has discharged its last Ebola patient - the seventh to recover from the virus - marking a major milestone in efforts to contain the disease in the East African nation, which now begins a 42-day countdown to officially being declared Ebola-free. It had confirmed its first ever case of Ebola early in October when a Kenyan businessman died within days of arriving in the capital, Nairobi. He had contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where more than 5,000 people have died in an ongoing outbreak that began in May. His mother also subsequently died. Kenya's health minister said 135 identified contacts of the infected patients had also completed their 21 days in isolation. "Today with the discharge of the last patient we can confirm and tell the world that seven patients have recovered - and all contacts have completed their follow-up monitoring," Aden Duale said. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) described it as an important achievement in the regional response to the outbreak. "This is an encouraging moment for Kenya and for Africa. We must sustain surveillance and vigilance until the outbreak is officially declared over," Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya posted on X. - What is Ebola and why is stopping the latest outbreak so difficult? - Published15 September Kenya has reported no new confirmed cases since 20 October. All the Kenyan cases were linked to the man who had travelled from DR Congo through Uganda, with health officials reporting no evidence of wider community transmission. Those who have recovered following treatment included four healthcare workers. Five patients were discharged on 3 November, followed by a sixth three days later, before the final patient was cleared on Wednesday. Under World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines, 42 days must pass after the last patient tests negative and is discharged, or the last Ebola victim is safely buried, before an outbreak can be declared over. The Ebola virus spreads through contact with infected bodily fluids such as blood or vomit. The incubation period ranges from two to 21 days, meaning those exposed to the virus may not become ill for several weeks. Duale said the government would maintain heightened surveillance at border crossings, airports, health facilities and communities throughout the countdown. Emergency response teams will remain on alert across the country, while the health authorities will continue monitoring travellers arriving from affected countries. Kenyans returning from Ebola-affected areas are required to complete electronic health declarations before travelling, undergo screening on arrival and spend 21 days in quarantine under the supervision of health teams. The minister also urged countries that had imposed travel and visa restrictions to reconsider them - adding that Kenya had no intention of serving as a quarantine centre for another country. In May, a Kenyan court suspended US plans to open an Ebola quarantine facility for American citizens. Kenya has maintained that there is no need to restrict domestic travel, trade or public gatherings. The outbreak has nevertheless disrupted international travel, with some Gulf countries introducing restrictions affecting travellers from Kenya and other African countries. Saudi Arabia stopped issuing visas to Kenyan nationals in late October, prompting concerns among those seeking employment there. Meanwhile, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) has announced that it is lifting its suspension on issuing new visas to Ugandan nationals, easing restrictions introduced in June. But Ugandans will have to spend at least 21 days outside of Uganda before being allowed to travel to the UAE. The UAE is also allowing certain students, diplomatic passport holders and Ugandan embassy employees to enter under approved health procedures. Uganda, which shares a long and busy border with DR Congo, was among the countries first affected but declared its own Ebola outbreak over on 27 August. The current outbreak in DR Congo has been caused by the Bundibugyo species of Ebola, which is relatively rare, with no approved vaccine or treatment - though trials are under way. - Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history - Published17 August Go to BBCAfrica.com, external for more news from the African continent. news.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
news.summary: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
news.summaryTr: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
news.articleText: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators. The Financial Stability Board (FSB) urged Turkey to tighten its oversight of crypto markets and adopt dedicated rules for stablecoins. In a peer review published on Wednesday, the global financial watchdog said Turkish authorities had made progress by introducing registration and licensing requirements for crypto service providers. The report was part of the FSB’s regular program of country reviews and assessed Turkey’s progress in implementing the board’s 2023 global recommendations on crypto and stablecoins. It followed a broader 2025 review that found gaps in how jurisdictions had implemented those recommendations. The FSB recommended that Turkey begin monitoring crypto-related risks to financial stability under a formal framework, strengthen supervision and enforcement, and improve cooperation and information sharing with foreign regulators. Turkey’s Capital Markets Board introduced licensing and operational requirements for crypto exchanges and custodians in March 2025, including minimum capital thresholds. The FSB said Turkey had introduced safeguards including requirements to segregate assets held in custody and a ban on domestic crypto payments. The safeguards help limit the spread of crypto-related risks to banks and payment systems. Authorities also launched a centralized platform to monitor crypto activities. The FSB’s 2025 review found that Turkey had finalized rules for crypto assets but lacked a dedicated stablecoin framework. In June 2025, Turkey’s Finance Ministry outlined plans to introduce additional transaction checks and limits on stablecoin transfers to combat money laundering. Related: Turkey tightens crypto rules with source, purpose checks on transfers

news.summary: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

news.titleTr: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
news.summaryTr: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.
news.articleText: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives. Zcash (ZEC) fell to a two-month low of $962.85 on Wednesday, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to nonprofits and projects supporting the Zcash network. As of 12:20 pm UTC Wednesday, Zcash’s 13.5% drop led 24-hour losses among the 100 largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization and was down 24.5% over seven days. The decline was part of a broader crypto sell-off that left Bitcoin (BTC) down 5.8% and Ether (ETH) down 11.6% over the same period, according to CoinGecko. Crypto prices fell further Tuesday after US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October from the previous month, above economists’ 0.3% forecast. Zcash lets users send shielded payments that keep sender and recipient addresses and transaction amounts out of public view. Zcash helped drive this year’s rally in privacy coins, gaining 138% in the 30 days to Sept. 7. It remains the largest privacy coin by market value, accounting for about 60% of the $28 billion category tracked by CoinGecko. The category’s combined market value fell about 7% over 24 hours. ZEC traded above $1,370 as recently as Friday, when Zcash activated its NU7 upgrade. The upgrade cut the target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25 to speed up transaction confirmations. It also made about 12,224 ZEC held in the network’s original privacy pool unspendable. Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust into a US spot exchange-traded fund (ETF) that began trading on NYSE Arca on Aug. 25. The fund recorded about $15 million in net outflows in November through Monday, following about $46 million in October, according to SoSoValue. Related: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
